digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter configuration and outbound field mapping
propositions: Priority mapping is made configuration-driven via str-keyed priority_map axis, mirroring existing status_map threading pattern through CREATE and UPDATE carriers
Unmapped priority values DRIFT by omitting the priority field and recording a warning, rather than failing the sync
Per-project create_defaults axis accepts str-valued mappings for required-beyond-baseline fields, merged into CREATE payloads only with baseline fields winning collisions

Priority map and create_defaults are resolved per-project via new helpers _effective_priority_map_for and _effective_create_defaults_for, then threaded through backend Protocol signatures as optional kwargs
Built-in priority baseline (0=Highest through 4=Lowest) is re-declared in config.py as str-keyed dict to avoid top-level imports and enable safe lookup by str(priority)
Test doubles on the threading path gain priority_map and create_defaults optional parameters, while **kwargs-based fakes already absorb new kwargs without modification
